scripts.docs:build: pnpm docs:kotlin && pnpm --filter zen-docs build && cp docs/build/client/404/index.html docs/build/client/404.html && mkdir -p docs/build/client/kotlin && cp -r kotlin/webApp/build/dist/wasmJs/productionExecutable docs/build/client/kotlin/demo && cp -r kotlin/zen/build/dokka/html docs/build/client/kotlin/api && pnpm --filter @rinzai/zen exec storybook build --output-dir ../docs/build/client/storybook
